history.title: Read an entity’s history
history.description: List every committed transaction that touched one entity, newest first. Each is returned as the patch it applied (the components it wrote, or $delete if it deleted the entity) stamped with who wrote it, when, and through which tool or process. The journal is written inside the same transaction as the change, so this gives attribution and a diff without a version table. It covers changes made since this graph started journaling.

entity.description: the entity whose history to read: an id, a name, or an eid

limit.description: return at most this many transactions, counting back from the newest
